# GSAP

OpenCatt does not ship GSAP. When the agent records its first video (OP-81), the app downloads
GSAP 3.15.0 from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/gsap.min.js, checks it against
SHA-384 XmJ9SoHtVOHoQUcKvFAzVXwdkKo1Ie3bhmSoIAkcdsHGaIrVJIkmozyq0FJeb/Ly and keeps a copy in the
app's data folder for later recordings.
